about: Authored frozen-art integration review record (reviewer decisions; spoiler-safe: ids, screen keys and generic descriptions only). tools/art-integration.mjs combines it with the live runtime to generate docs/art_integration/INTEGRATION_MATRIX.json. Statuses that the runtime can prove (integrated, placeholder, no art) are derived, never authored here.

bruce_loose.bow.note: No scene narrates a bow; the lesson beat could carry it but the content does not say so. Needs a Story/HQ call before wiring.

deacon_brass.blessing.note: Armory beats mention grace but never narrate a blessing gesture.

hilt.walk_away.note: A23 'leave' narrates Hilt leaving, but Hilt is never on stage in that adventure (entrance line only); wiring it would add a cast member to the beat.

iron_jaw.rapping.note: The battle itself is the BARS minigame (UI overlay); no adventure beat shows him mid-verse.
